senses.gloss: c. (= לֶפֶס q. v.) a tightly covered pot, stew-pot, contrad. to קדירה a boiling pot.
units: <cite ref="Nedarim 51a">Ned. 51ᵃ</cite> a dish goes first in a pot <he>קודם שיורד לאי׳</he> before it is put in a stew-pot for steaming.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Challah 1:4:7">Y. Ḥall. I, 58ᵃ</cite> top.—
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 1">Gen. R. s. 1</cite>, end <he>כא׳ וכיסויו</he> as a pot with its lid.—Pl. <he>אִלְפְּסִין</he>.
